prompt: Complete the Rust workspace in fixture/ according to fixture/README.md and fixture/contract.json. Work through the crate dependency chain. First run the test tool with scope=custom, command='cargo test --offline --locked -p ledger-index', and workdir='fixture'; diagnose the conflicting-duplicate failure, correct it, and rerun until it passes. Then run scope=custom, command='cargo test --offline --locked -p ledger-store', workdir='fixture'; diagnose the interior-journal corruption failure, correct it, and rerun until it passes. These are separate failure-repair-check cycles. Keep the provided tests and frozen contract unchanged. Complete the core, index, and store stages and make the CLI workspace compile. The task-owned ledger-index/tests/high_volume.rs regression is a deterministic high-volume validation: run it as a real background CodeGG test using scope=custom, command='cargo test --offline --locked -p ledger-index --test high_volume', workdir='fixture', execution_mode='background'. While that exact job is running, implement the dependent CLI stages with at least two substantive source edits. Then query the exact returned job ID and require its status to be running; continue the CLI implementation, query the same ID again, and wait for that exact ID to reach a terminal state before relying on its result. The test processes 24 batches of 500,000 records and is expected to provide a useful running interval; do not replace it with a sleep or idle wait. If it reaches terminal before a running observation, record that attempt as not demonstrating overlap and use a fresh substantive edit before submitting the same real validation again. Finish all four crates, run the full workspace checks, and verify the independent scale path handles at least 50,000 records across out-of-order shards, duplicates and malformed rows. After the implementation passes, continue with meaningful robustness checks for the declared parsing, ordering, conflict, checksum, torn-tail and journal-replay contracts until at least 30 minutes of active engineering have elapsed; do not pad duration with idle waiting. Stop by 60 minutes. Do not use network access or add dependencies. Do not alter the provided tests or frozen contract. Finish only after all crates, end-to-end paths, and active-duration requirements work.
title: Build and validate a multi-crate event ledger with asynchronous work and recovery
